questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to share the use of a private road on the landowner's land so that the neighbor could have more convenient access to the neighbor's land. Only the landowner maintained the road. After the neighbor had used the road on a daily basis for three years, the landowner conveyed his land to a grantee, who immediately notified the neighbor that the neighbor was not to use the road. The neighbor sued the grantee, seeking a declaration that the neighbor had a right to continue to use the road.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The grantee, because an oral license is invalid.
choices.B: The grantee, because the neighbor had a license that the grantee could terminate at any time.
choices.C: The neighbor, because the grantee is estopped from terminating the neighbor's use of the road.
choices.D: The neighbor, because the neighbor's use of the road was open and notorious when the grantee purchased the land.

questions.explanation:
Licenses, easements & profits
License Revocable privilege to enter & use another's land for specific purpose
Easement Nonpossessory interest in land that gives easement holder right to:
  • use another's land for specific purpose (ie, affirmative easement) or
  • prohibit other owner from doing something on land that owner would otherwise be allowed to do (ie, negative easement)
Profit Nonpossessory interest in land that gives profit holder right to enter another's land to remove products of soil (eg, timber, minerals, oil)

A license is a grant of permission to enter and use another's land for a specific purpose. Unlike easements, licenses do not create an interest in the land. As a result, they are not subject to the statute of frauds and can be created orally or by another act demonstrating the licensor's intent to let the licensee enter the property (Choice A). Licenses can generally be revoked at any time and terminate automatically upon (1) the death of either party or (2) conveyance of the licensed property.

Here, the landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to use a private road on his land. This created a license, which terminated automatically when the landowner conveyed his land to the grantee. Additionally, the grantee's immediately notifying the neighbor to stop using the road demonstrates that the grantee did not intend to revive the license. As a result, the neighbor has no right to continue to use the road, and the grantee is likely to prevail.

(Choice C) A license may become irrevocable, and the licensor may be estopped (ie, precluded) from revoking it, if the licensee expends substantial money, labor, or other resources in reliance on the license. But estoppel does not apply here since the landowner alone maintained the road and there is nothing to suggest that the neighbor expended any resources to use it.

(Choice D) Open and notorious use goes to determining whether a prescriptive easement was acquired. But the neighbor's use of the road was with the landowner's permission, which negates the nonpermissive use required for such an easement.

📌 Educational Objective

A license is a grant of permission to enter and use another's land for a specific purpose. It can be revoked at any time and terminates automatically upon (1) the death of either party or (2) conveyance of the licensed property.

📚 References
  • Restatement of Property §§ 515, 519 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (creation and revocation of licenses).
  • Rau v. Collins, 891 A.2d 1175, 1184 (Md. App. 2006) (stating that a license terminates automatically upon sale of the licensed property).
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者口头允许其邻居共享使用其土地上的一条私人道路，以便邻居可以更方便地进入其邻居的土地。只有该土地所有者维护这条道路。邻居每天使用该道路三年后，土地所有者将其土地转让给了一位受让人。受让人立即通知邻居不得再使用该道路。邻居起诉了受让人，请求法院宣告其有权继续使用该道路。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 受让人，因为口头许可是无效的。
zh-choices.B: 受让人，因为邻居拥有的许可，受让人可以随时终止。
zh-choices.C: 邻居，因为根据禁止反言原则，受让人不得终止邻居对道路的使用。
zh-choices.D: 邻居，因为在受让人购买土地时，邻居对道路的使用是公开且众所周知的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

不动产法：许可 vs. 地役权

✅ 正确答案：B

受让人胜诉。因为邻居持有的是一份许可 (License)，该许可在土地转让时自动终止，或者受让人有权随时撤销。

核心概念：许可 (License)

许可是进入或许可使用他人土地的特权 (Privilege)，而非土地权益 (Interest in land)。

  • 形式：通常是口头的 (Oral)。
  • 可撤销性：原则上可随时撤销 (Revocable at will)。
  • 不可转让性：通常是个人的 (Personal)，不可转让。
  • 终止：当土地被出售/转让 (Conveyance) 时，原有的许可自动终止。
1. 权利的定性：
题目中，土地所有者“口头允许” (Orally gave permission) 邻居使用道路。这种口头的、基于人情的准许，在法律上被认定为许可 (License)，而不是地役权 (Easement)。地役权通常需要书面形式以满足《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds)。
2. 土地转让的后果：
当原土地所有者将土地转让给受让人 (Grantee) 时，法律规则规定：许可随土地转让而自动终止。因此，受让人没有义务继续允许邻居使用道路。

许可 vs. 地役权

特征 许可 (License) 地役权 (Easement)
性质 一种特权 (Privilege) 土地权益 (Property Interest)
创建方式 口头即可 (Oral is OK) 通常需书面 (Writing required)
撤销 随时可撤销 (Revocable) 不可随意撤销

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (无效论)： 口头许可并非“无效”，它是有效的，只是它很脆弱，可以被随时撤销。
❌ 选项 C (禁止反言 Estoppel)： 如果被许可人投入了大量资金或劳力 (Detrimental Reliance)，许可可能变为不可撤销 (Irrevocable License)。但本题明确指出“只有土地所有者维护道路”，邻居没有投入成本，因此不适用禁止反言原则。
❌ 选项 D (时效地役权 Prescriptive Easement)： 时效地役权要求使用是“敌意的” (Hostile/Adverse)。本题中邻居的使用是经过许可的 (Permissive)，许可的存在直接否定了敌意性，因此无法形成时效地役权。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 "Oral permission" (口头允许) 使用土地，第一反应应当是 License (许可)。

紧接着检查是否有 Reliance (信赖利益/投入资金)：
  • 如果有投入 -> Irrevocable License (Estoppel)
  • 如果没有投入 -> Revocable at will (随时可撤销)

question_analysis.skill_tested: Distinguish revocable license from easement

reason.en: Oral permission creates a license, not an easement subject to the statute of frauds.
reason.zh: 口头准许构成许可，而非须遵守欺诈法 Statute of Frauds 的地役权。

reason.en: Defines the limited purpose for which entry onto the servient land was allowed.
reason.zh: 界定被允许进入他人土地的具体用途范围。

keywords.text: Only the landowner maintained the road

reason.en: Shows the neighbor did not rely by spending money or labor, defeating estoppel.
reason.zh: 表明邻居未因信赖而支出金钱或劳务，排除禁止反言。

reason.en: Extended use was with permission, so it does not ripen into a prescriptive easement.
reason.zh: 长期使用系经许可进行，不能形成时效地役权。

keywords.text: conveyed his land to a grantee

reason.en: A license automatically terminates when the licensed property is conveyed.
reason.zh: 许可土地转让时，许可自动终止。

keywords.text: a right to continue to use the road

reason.en: The neighbor seeks an ongoing property-like right rather than a mere revocable privilege.
reason.zh: 邻居主张的是持续性的财产性权利，而非可随时撤销的特权。

reason.en: Licenses are not subject to the statute of frauds and may be created orally.
reason.zh: 许可不受欺诈法规制，可以口头设立。

reason.en: Correctly identifies the neighbor's interest as a nonpossessory, revocable permission.
reason.zh: 正确将邻居的利益定性为无占有权、可撤销的准许。

reason.en: States the governing rule that ended the neighbor's right upon conveyance and notice.
reason.zh: 说明转让及通知后邻居权利终止的适用规则。

reason.en: Estoppel requires substantial reliance expenditure, which is absent here.
reason.zh: 禁止反言须以重大信赖支出为前提，本案不存在。

reason.en: Open and notorious use alone does not create an easement when use was permissive.
reason.zh: 公然使用本身不足以在经许可使用时成立地役权。

highlights.text: orally gave his neighbor permission

reason.en: Triggers license analysis instead of an easement or covenant in writing.
reason.zh: 触发许可规则分析，而非书面地役权或契约。

highlights.text: Only the landowner maintained the road

reason.en: Negates irrevocable-license estoppel based on money, labor, or resources spent.
reason.zh: 排除邻居因金钱、劳务或其他资源投入而产生的不可撤销许可。

highlights.text: conveyed his land to a grantee

reason.en: Conveyance of the servient estate ends the prior license by operation of law.
reason.zh: 供役地转让依法终止原有许可。

highlights.text: used the road on a daily basis for three years

reason.en: Length and openness do not convert permitted use into a prescriptive easement.
reason.zh: 使用时间长且公开，并不能将经许可使用转化为时效地役权。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman acquired land by a deed that contained the following language in the grantee section: "to [the woman], her heirs and assigns, provided, however, that said grantee may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years from the date of this instrument."
Two years later, the woman contracted to sell the land to an investor for a price based on a recent appraisal. When the investor's title search revealed the above language in the grantee section of the deed to the woman, the investor refused to close the transaction. The contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation.
The woman has sued the investor for specific performance.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The investor, because the woman cannot sell the land during the 10-year period specified in the deed.
choices.B: The investor, because the woman's heirs did not join in the contract.
choices.C: The woman, because the contract did not obligate her to provide marketable title.
choices.D: The woman, because the deed's restraint on transfer is void as a matter of law.

questions.explanation:
Restraints on alienation

(restrictions on transferability of real property)

Validity Examples
Direct
(disfavored)
  • Only valid if reasonable
  • Balance utility of restraint against harm resulting from enforcement
  • Prohibiting some or all types of transfers
  • Prohibiting transfer without consent
  • Prohibiting transfer to particular persons
Indirect Valid unless lacking rational justification
  • Imposing transfer fees
  • Limiting property's use/reducing its value

A restraint on alienation is a restriction on the transferability of an interest in property. Direct restraints are disfavored and are valid only if they are deemed reasonable. Courts balance the utility of the restraint against the harm resulting from its enforcement. A total restraint on the alienation of a fee simple estate is always unreasonable and void.

A woman executed a deed conveying a fee simple estate that included a provision prohibiting any transfer of the property for 10 years. This provision constitutes a direct restraint on alienation and, because it prohibits all transfers for a specified period, it is a total restraint on a fee simple estate. The deed's words of limitation—"and her heirs"—indicate a fee simple estate. Because the restraint is a total restraint on a fee simple estate, it is void as a matter of law. Thus, the woman can sell the land, and the investor cannot avoid the contract on this basis (Choice A).

(Choice B) The phrase "and her heirs" in the deed conveys a fee simple estate but does not give the heirs an ownership interest in the property. Therefore, the woman's heirs did not need to join in the contract.

(Choice C) Every contract for the sale of land contains an implied obligation to deliver marketable title at closing. It does not matter that the contract did not expressly state this obligation.

📌 Educational Objective

Direct restraints on alienation (eg, prohibitions on some or all types of transfers) are valid only if they are deemed reasonable. Total restraints on the alienability of fee simple estates are always unreasonable.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (direct restraints on alienation).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子通过一份契约获得了一块土地，契约的受让人部分包含以下语言：“授予[该女子]、其继承人和受让人，但前提是，所述受让人自本文件签订之日起10年内不得转让该土地的任何权益。”

两年后，该女子签订合同，以近期评估价为基础将该土地出售给一名投资者。当投资者的产权调查发现授予该女子的契约受让人部分存在上述语言时，投资者拒绝完成交易。合同对该女子的产权义务未作规定。

该女子已起诉投资者，要求其强制履行合同。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 投资者，因为该女子在契约规定的10年期限内不能出售该土地。
zh-choices.B: 投资者，因为该女子的继承人没有加入合同。
zh-choices.C: 该女子，因为合同没有规定她必须提供可售卖产权。
zh-choices.D: 该女子，因为契约中的转让限制在法律上是无效的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Restraints on Alienation

核心法律规则

本题考察的是不动产法中关于转让限制 (Restraints on Alienation) 的规则。

一般规则：
法律倾向于财产的自由流通。因此，对绝对完全保有地产权 (Fee Simple Absolute) 施加的直接转让限制通常是不受法律支持的。

转让限制主要分为三类：

  • 禁止性限制 (Disabling Restraint)：规定转让无效。
  • 没收性限制 (Forfeiture Restraint)：规定若转让则失去产权。
  • 承诺性限制 (Promissory Restraint)：合同承诺不转让。

MBE 黄金法则：
对于 Fee Simple Estate（完全保有地产），任何试图完全禁止转让（哪怕是暂时的，如10年）的条款都是无效的 (Void)。

图解：限制的有效性
Fee Simple
(完全保有地产)

完全禁止转让
(Total Restraint)
⬇
无效 (Void)
Life Estate
(终身地产)

合理的没收性限制
(Forfeiture Restraint)
⬇
可能有效 (Valid)

*注：本题属于左侧情况。虽然只是10年的限制，但对于Fee Simple来说，禁止任何形式的转让被视为“完全限制”，因此无效。

本案逻辑推演
1
确定地产类型：
契约使用了 "to [the woman], her heirs and assigns"（授予该女子、其继承人和受让人）。这是设立 Fee Simple Absolute 的经典语言。
2
识别限制条款：
条款规定 "may not transfer... for 10 years"（10年内不得转让）。这属于直接的转让限制。
3
应用法律后果：
由于这是对 Fee Simple 的直接限制，该限制条款自始无效 (Void ab initio)。
4
结论：
既然限制无效，该女子拥有完全的处分权。她可以出售土地，且产权是清晰的。因此，她有权要求强制履行 (Specific Performance)。
为什么选 D？

正确答案 D 指出契约中的转让限制在法律上是无效的。这直接切中了问题的核心：虽然契约里写了不让卖，但这行字在法律眼中是“透明”的，不产生效力。

其他选项为何错误？

  • 选项 A (错误)： 认为限制有效。这是对法律规则的误解，Fee Simple 上的 Total Restraint 总是无效的。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 提到“继承人未加入合同”。在 "to A and her heirs" 中，"and her heirs" 是限定词 (Words of Limitation)，仅表示地产的类型是永久的，并不给继承人任何当前的权益。继承人无权干涉买卖。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 认为合同未规定“可售卖产权 (Marketable Title)”。实际上，所有土地销售合同都默示 (Implied) 包含提供 Marketable Title 的义务，除非明确排除。沉默不代表没有义务。
MBE 提分锦囊
  • 🚩 看到 "Heirs" 不要慌： 只要出现在 "To A and her heirs" 这种格式里，它只是用来定义 Fee Simple 的，继承人没有任何权利 (No interest)。
  • 🚩 区分限制类型：
    • 如果是 Fee Simple + 禁止转让 ➡ 限制无效，可以卖。
    • 如果是 Co-tenancy (共有) + 协议限制分割 ➡ 如果时间合理，可能有效。
    • 如果是 Right of First Refusal (优先购买权) ➡ 如果价格合理且期限合理，通常有效。
  • 🚩 Marketable Title： 永远默示存在。如果题目说“合同没写”，不要以为就没有这个义务。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Recognize void total alienation restraints

reason.en: Signals the grantee received a fee simple estate subject to the restraint.
reason.zh: 表明受让人取得的是附带转让限制的绝对所有权。

keywords.text: may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years

reason.en: A complete ban on transfers for a fixed period is a total restraint on alienation.
reason.zh: 在特定期限内完全禁止转让构成完全转让限制。

keywords.text: contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation

label.zh: 默示可售产权义务问题

reason.en: Tests whether an implied marketable-title duty still applies despite silence.
reason.zh: 测试合同未写明时是否仍负有默示可售产权义务。

reason.en: The investor's refusal triggers the dispute over title and enforceability.
reason.zh: 投资者拒付引发关于产权与限制可执行性的争议。

reason.en: The remedy sought depends on whether the contract remains enforceable.
reason.zh: 所请求的救济取决于合同是否仍可强制执行。

keywords.text: 10 years from the date of this instrument

reason.en: Shows the restraint is temporal and prohibits all transfers during that window.
reason.zh: 表明该限制具有时间性且在该期间内禁止一切转让。

A.text: cannot sell the land during the 10-year period

reason.en: Treats the deed restriction as enforceable even though a total fee simple restraint is void.
reason.zh: 将契据限制视为可执行，但绝对所有权的完全限制依法无效。

reason.en: Focuses on the written prohibition instead of its invalidity on a fee simple estate.
reason.zh: 仅关注书面禁止条款，忽略其在绝对所有权上的无效性。

B.text: heirs did not join in the contract

reason.en: Misreads 'heirs' as present owners rather than words creating a fee simple.
reason.zh: 误将'继承人'理解为现所有权人，而非创设绝对所有权的用语。

C.text: did not obligate her to provide marketable title

reason.en: Ignores the implied obligation to deliver marketable title in land-sale contracts.
reason.zh: 忽略土地买卖合同中默示的可售产权交付义务。

reason.en: Even without an express clause, the seller must convey marketable title at closing.
reason.zh: 即使合同未明示，卖方在交割时仍须提供可售产权。

D.text: restraint on transfer is void as a matter of law

reason.en: States the controlling rule that voids the deed's total restraint on a fee simple.
reason.zh: 陈述使契据中对绝对所有权的完全限制无效的控制性规则。

D.text: void as a matter of law

reason.en: Confirms the restraint fails without a reasonableness balancing inquiry.
reason.zh: 表明该限制无需进行合理性衡量即归于无效。

highlights.text: may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years from the date of this instrument

reason.en: This language creates the direct total restraint whose validity controls the answer.
reason.zh: 该用语构成直接完全转让限制，其效力决定本题答案。

highlights.text: her heirs and assigns

reason.en: Identifies the estate type to which the total-restraint voidness rule applies.
reason.zh: 确定适用完全限制无效规则的不动产权利类型。

highlights.text: contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation

reason.en: Tests a secondary trap about whether the seller still must deliver marketable title.
reason.zh: 测试卖方是否仍须交付可售产权的次要陷阱。

highlights.text: The woman has sued the investor for specific performance

reason.en: Frames the dispute as whether the sale contract can be enforced despite the deed language.
reason.zh: 将争议框定为契据用语存在时销售合同是否仍可强制执行。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Ten years ago, a couple bought a building and moved into its second-floor apartment with their teenage daughter. The couple operated a shoe store on the first floor of the building for many years. When the couple purchased the building, the area was predominantly rural and was zoned for nonresidential use. The municipality's zoning is cumulative.
Five years ago, the municipality rezoned the area to single-family residential use. The daughter was not aware of this change because she was away at college.
Recently, the daughter inherited the building from her parents. The daughter immediately moved into the apartment and took over the operation of the shoe store on the first floor. The daughter has learned that a developer is planning to build a large residential community in the area surrounding her building.
The daughter has asked her lawyer for advice regarding her ability to continue operating the shoe store.
Should the lawyer advise the daughter that she can continue to operate her shoe store?

choices.A: No, because the nonconforming use of the building terminated when the daughter's parents died.
choices.B: No, but the municipality must pay her reasonable compensation for her loss resulting from the change in zoning.
choices.C: Yes, because the shoe store is a nonconforming use.
choices.D: Yes, because the zoning is cumulative and the building is also used for single-family residential purposes.

questions.explanation:
Cumulative zoning
(permits higher use in lower-use zones)
Single-family
Multi-family
Commercial
Light-industrial
Heavy-industrial
High
Low

A nonconforming use arises when property was used in a lawful manner before a zoning law was enacted and that use continues even though it is now prohibited. The owner has a "grandfathered right" to continue the use unless: (1) it is enlarged, changed, or abandoned, or (2) the zoning law provides an amortization period or requires registration which has not been met.

Here, the building was in a nonresidential area when the couple began operating a shoe store. When the area was rezoned to single-family residential, the store became a nonconforming use. Because the store was continuously operated—first by the couple and then by their daughter after they died—she can continue to operate it. (Choice C)

Under the Fifth Amendment takings clause, a municipality must pay compensation when a law takes private property for public use (eg, by depriving the property of all or nearly all of its economic value). However, no compensation is required here because the zoning law does not affect the daughter's ability to continue operating the shoe store. (Choice B)

Zoning is cumulative when it permits a higher use in a lower use zone. Here, the area was rezoned to the "highest" use (residential), so the "lower" commercial use cannot exist in that zone unless it is a nonconforming use. The fact that the building is also used for single-family residential purposes does not change the commercial character of the shoe store. (Choice D)

📌 Educational Objective

A nonconforming use may continue until (1) the owner enlarges, changes, or abandons that use or (2) if provided in the zoning law, an amortization period has passed or the use has not been registered.

📚 References
  • Pa. Nw. Distribs., Inc. v. Zoning Hearing Bd., 584 A.2d 1372, 1375–76 (Pa. 1991) (describing the right to and termination of a nonconforming use).
  • 83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning & Planning §§ 524–93 (2019).
questions.zh-question:
十年前，一对夫妇买下了一栋楼，并与他们十几岁的女儿一起搬进了二楼的公寓。这对夫妇在该楼的一楼经营鞋店多年。当这对夫妇购买这栋楼时，该地区主要为乡村地区，并被划为非住宅用途区。该市的区划是累积性的。

五年前，该市将该地区重新划为单户住宅用途区。女儿对此变更不知情，因为她当时在外地上大学。

最近，女儿从父母那里继承了这栋楼。女儿立即搬进了公寓，并接管了一楼鞋店的经营。女儿了解到，一位开发商正计划在她的大楼周围地区建造一个大型住宅社区。

女儿向她的律师咨询了关于她是否能继续经营鞋店的建议。

律师是否应该建议女儿她可以继续经营她的鞋店？

zh-choices.A: 不应该，因为当女儿的父母去世时，该建筑的不合规定用途已经终止。
zh-choices.B: 不应该，但市政府必须为她因区划变更而造成的损失支付合理补偿。
zh-choices.C: 应该，因为鞋店是一种不合规定用途。
zh-choices.D: 应该，因为区划是累积性的，并且该建筑也用于单户住宅目的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Zoning
✅ 正确答案：C

是的，因为鞋店属于不合规定用途 (Nonconforming Use)，享有继续经营的权利。

核心概念：不合规定用途 (Nonconforming Use)

当政府修改区划法（Zoning Ordinance）时，如果某项财产在修改之前已经合法存在并使用，但修改后不再符合新的区划要求，该用途即成为不合规定用途。

⚖️ 法律规则：
不合规定用途的所有者拥有“祖父权利”（Grandfathered Right），可以继续该用途，直到：
  1. 用途被扩大、改变或放弃 (Abandoned)；
  2. 或者（如果法律规定）摊销期 (Amortization Period) 已过。
本案逻辑推演
  • 1
    初始状态合法：
    10年前购买时，该区域划为非住宅区，经营鞋店是合法的 (Lawful)。
  • 2
    区划变更：
    5年前，区域被重新划为“单户住宅区” (Single-family residential)。此时鞋店变得不合规。
  • 3
    持续使用：
    鞋店一直由父母经营，随后由女儿接手，中间没有中断，也没有扩大规模或改变性质。

结论：女儿有权继续经营。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A：父母去世导致权利终止？

错误。 不合规定用途是随土地转移的 (Runs with the land)，而不是随人转移的。只要用途本身没有被放弃（Abandonment），所有权的变更（如继承、出售）不会终止该权利。

❌ 选项 D：累积性区划 (Cumulative Zoning)？

错误。 这是一个常见的陷阱。

Cumulative Zoning 通常意味着：
高级别用途（如住宅）可以存在于低级别区域（如商业/工业区）。

但在本案中，情况正好相反：试图在高级别区域（住宅区）保留低级别用途（商业鞋店）。无论区划是否是累积性的，商业用途通常都不允许在纯住宅区存在，除非它是不合规定用途。因此，C 是比 D 更准确的法律依据。

❌ 选项 B：政府赔偿 (Compensation)？

错误。 只有当区划变更导致财产完全丧失经济价值（Regulatory Taking）时，才需要赔偿。这里女儿仍可居住或继续经营（作为不合规定用途），并未丧失所有价值。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“Zoning Change”（区划变更）+ “Existing Business”（现有业务）的组合，首先要反应出 Nonconforming Use。

关键判断点： 1. 变更前是否合法？ 2. 使用是否连续（未放弃）？
如果都是 Yes，则受保护。
MBE Real Property Review
© 2025 Legal Exam Prep

question_analysis.skill_tested: apply nonconforming use grandfather rights

reason.en: Establishes the shoe store began as a lawful use before the residential rezone.
reason.zh: 表明鞋店在改为住宅分区前属于合法用途。

reason.en: Signals a distractor about whether lower uses are automatically permitted.
reason.zh: 提示考生勿误以为较低用途因累积分区而自动合法。

keywords.text: rezoned the area to single-family residential use

reason.en: Creates the conflict making the continued commercial use nonconforming.
reason.zh: 造成商业用途与现行住宅分区冲突。

reason.en: The continuous commercial operation is the use protected as nonconforming.
reason.zh: 持续经营的鞋店即受保护的非合规用途。

reason.en: Tests whether succession by death terminates the grandfathered right.
reason.zh: 检验继承是否终止既得非合规使用权。

reason.en: Frames the legal issue as whether the grandfathered right survives.
reason.zh: 界定问题在于既得使用权能否继续。

reason.en: Correct doctrine, but paired with a false termination trigger.
reason.zh: 概念正确，但搭配了错误的终止事由。

reason.en: Implies the right ended upon the parents' death, which is incorrect.
reason.zh: 暗示父母去世即终止使用权，属错误说法。

reason.en: Misleads by treating inheritance as abandonment or termination.
reason.zh: 误导考生将继承视为放弃或终止用途。

reason.en: Invokes Fifth Amendment compensation without a compensable taking.
reason.zh: 在无应补偿征收时援引第五修正案补偿。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man conveyed a valid easement appurtenant across his ranch to a woman who owned the adjoining property, on which she operated a commercial farm. The easement was not recorded. Shortly before his death, the man devised his ranch to his son. The will made no mention of the woman's easement. The son, who lived out-of-state, never came to visit the ranch. The woman decided to expand the size of her crops and openly used the man's ranch to do so. She paid the taxes on the property and used the land exclusively for 20 years. However, she never used the easement during that time.
After facing some financial hardship, the son decided to sell the ranch. To prevent the sale, the woman filed and won a quiet-title suit confirming that she had acquired ownership of the ranch through adverse possession. The son felt guilty about losing his father's ranch, so he worked out a deal with the woman to repurchase the ranch.
After the sale, the woman resumed her use of the easement across the ranch that had been granted to her by the man. The son, already angry over having to repurchase the ranch, immediately objected to the woman entering his property. The woman has filed suit to enforce the easement.
The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.
Will the woman likely prevail?

choices.A: No, because she acquired title to the ranch through adverse possession.
choices.B: No, because the son was not provided proper notice of the easement.
choices.C: Yes, because an easement appurtenant automatically runs with the land.
choices.D: Yes, because failure to use an easement does not extinguish it.

questions.explanation:
Easement created by (WIPE):
  • Writing
  • Implication/Necessity
  • Prescription
  • Estoppel
Benefits land or easement holder?
Land
Easement Appurtenant automatically transfers when land is conveyed
Easement holder
Easement in Gross does not transfer when land is conveyed
Terminated by (DAMPER):
  • Destruction of servient estate
  • Abandonment
  • Merger
  • Prescription
  • Estoppel
  • Release (satisfying statute of frauds)

The man granted an easement appurtenant across his ranch. The ranch is the servient estate, and the woman's farm is the dominant estate. This type of easement runs with the land but is subject to recording acts.

The jurisdiction has a notice recording act. The son, who was devised the ranch, is not a "purchaser for value" and thus is not protected by the act. The lack of notice is of no consequence (Choice B).

Under the merger doctrine, an easement will terminate when the dominant estate and servient estate merge into the hands of a single owner. This happened when the woman acquired title to both properties. The easement was extinguished (Choice C).

A terminated easement cannot be revived by resevering the estates; a new one must be created. Since no new easement was created, the woman will not prevail.

*Easements are presumed to be appurtenant unless otherwise stated.

(Choice D) Abandonment requires an affirmative act showing intent to relinquish; "mere nonuse" is insufficient. The easement was terminated by merger instead.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the merger doctrine, an easement terminates once the dominant and servient estates merge into the hands of a single owner.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination of easement by merger).

一名男子将其牧场上的一项有效从属地役权（easement appurtenant）转让给了一位拥有相邻土地的女性，该女性在其土地上经营一个商业农场。该地役权未被登记。在去世前不久，该男子通过遗嘱将其牧场遗赠给了他的儿子。遗嘱中没有提及该女性的地役权。儿子住在州外，从未前来探访过该牧场。该女性决定扩大其作物种植规模，并为此公开使用了该男子的牧场。她支付了该地产的税款，并独占地使用了该土地长达20年。然而，在此期间她从未使用过该地役权。

在遭遇一些财务困境后，儿子决定出售该牧场。为阻止出售，该女性提起并赢得了一场确认产权诉讼，确认她已通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）获得了该牧场的所有权。儿子对于失去父亲的牧场感到内疚，因此他与该女性达成协议，回购了该牧场。

出售后，该女性恢复使用了由该男子授予她的、穿越该牧场的地役权。儿子本就因不得不回购牧场而感到愤怒，他立即反对该女性进入他的地产。该女性已提起诉讼，要求强制执行该地役权。

该司法管辖区实行登记告知法案（notice recording act）。

该女性是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为她通过侵权逆占获得了该牧场的所有权。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为儿子没有得到关于该地役权的适当通知。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为从属地役权自动随土地转移。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为未使用地役权并不会使其消灭。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easement Termination
正确答案：A 否，因为她通过侵权逆占（Adverse Possession）获得了该牧场的所有权。

核心考点是地役权的消灭方式之一：混同原则 (Merger Doctrine)。

逻辑推演 (Legal Reasoning)
1. 初始状态：
女性拥有农场（需役地 Dominant Estate），并拥有穿越牧场（供役地 Servient Estate）的地役权。
2. 侵权逆占 (Adverse Possession)：
女性占有牧场20年并赢得确认产权诉讼（Quiet Title）。此时，她同时拥有了农场和牧场的所有权。
3. 混同 (Merger) 发生：
这是解题的关键点。当需役地和供役地的所有权归于同一人时，地役权自动消灭。因为一个人不能在自己的土地上拥有地役权（你拥有完整的土地所有权，不需要额外的“通过权”）。
4. 出售与结果：
当女性将牧场卖回给儿子时，已消灭的地役权不会自动复活。除非在出售时重新设立（Express Grant/Reservation）或满足默示地役权的条件，否则该地役权不复存在。
排除干扰项 (Distractor Analysis)

❌ 选项 B (Notice / Recording Act):
这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。虽然该司法管辖区有登记告知法案，且地役权未登记，但儿子是通过遗嘱继承 (Devise) 获得牧场的，并非“有偿购买者” (Bona Fide Purchaser for Value)。因此，登记法案不保护儿子。但这不重要，因为后续的“混同”才是终结地役权的真正原因。

❌ 选项 C (Runs with the land):
地役权确实通常随土地转移，但前提是该地役权仍然存在。在本案中，地役权在转移前已经因混同而消灭了。

❌ 选项 D (Non-use):
单纯的“不使用”确实不足以消灭地役权（需要有抛弃的意图）。但是，本案中地役权的消灭不是因为不使用，而是因为所有权的混同。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
当你看到题目中出现“一个人最终拥有了两块相关的土地”（Unity of Ownership）的情节时，立即联想 Merger Doctrine（混同原则）。

记住口诀：Buy the land, kill the easement.（买下供役地，杀死地役权）。一旦消灭，除非重新创建，否则永不复活。
MBE Real Property Review

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner granted a sawmill the exclusive right to remove timber from the landowner's property for 10 years in exchange for a quarterly payment based on the size, type, and number of trees removed. Three years later, the sawmill purchased the landowner's property and built a facility for processing timber on the property. Eight years after purchasing the property, the sawmill sold the timbered portion of the land to a buyer, while retaining the portion of the land on which the processing facility was located. The contract made no specific mention of the prior recorded agreement, but the sawmill had come to rely on the supply of timber from the property. Although there are other sources of timber, timber is a necessary raw material for the sawmill. The buyer has refused to permit the sawmill to continue to remove timber from the property purchased by the buyer.
Which of the following is the sawmill's best argument for the continued existence of a profit?

choices.A: The buyer is estopped from denying the existence of the profit due to the sawmill's reliance on the property as its source for timber.
choices.B: The profit exists by implication.
choices.C: The profit was created by written agreement.
choices.D: Timber is necessary for the sawmill to operate.

questions.explanation:
Easements v. Profits
(methods of creation)
<
Easements v. Profits
(methods of creation)
Express grant
or reservation		NecessityExisting prior
use		PrescriptionEstoppel
Easements✓✓✓
Express grant or reservationNecessityExisting prior usePrescriptionEstoppel
Easements✓✓✓✓✓
Profits✓✓✓✓

A profit (ie, profit à prendre) is a nonpossessory right to enter another’s land and remove specific natural resources (eg, oil, game, timber—as seen here). Profits are generally created and analyzed similarly to easements. As a result, a profit can be implied from an existing prior use if the following elements are met:

  • Severance of common ownership – the dominant (benefited) and servient (burdened) estates were once a single tract of land, after which the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another
  • Prior existing use – the owner used the servient estate to benefit the dominant estate
  • Apparent and continuous – prior use was discoverable by a reasonable inspection and continued until the tract was severed
  • Reasonable necessity – continuation of the prior use is reasonably necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land

Here, the sawmill owned the entire property before selling the timbered portion to a buyer. The sawmill had been apparently and continuously removing timber from the land until the sale. And the continued removal of timber is reasonably necessary since the sawmill has come to rely on the supply of timber from the buyer’s land to operate. Therefore, the sawmill’s best argument is that the profit exists by implication.

(Choice A) A profit can be created by estoppel if the profit holder, in good faith, reasonably and detrimentally relies on permission from the owner of the land that serves as the source of the profit (not seen here).

(Choice B) Although the original landowner granted the sawmill a profit by written agreement (ie, an express profit), the profit terminated by merger when the sawmill acquired the property to which the profit was tied.

(Choice D) Profits are usually analyzed in the same manner as easements, but profits cannot be created by necessity. Additionally, the availability of other sources of timber would prevent the sawmill from establishing the strict necessity required to create an easement by necessity.

📌 Educational Objective

Profits are generally created and analyzed like easements, so a profit can be implied from an existing prior use.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes §167, 1.2(e), cmt. e (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement and profit defined).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes §167, 2.12 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (servitudes implied from prior use).

questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者授予一家锯木厂从其土地上采伐木材的独家权利，为期10年，以换取根据采伐树木的大小、种类和数量支付的季度款项。三年后，该锯木厂购买了该土地所有者的地产，并在该地产上建造了一个木材加工设施。购买该地产八年后，锯木厂将土地上的林木部分出售给一位买方，同时保留了加工设施所在的土地部分。合同没有具体提及先前的已记录协议，但锯木厂已开始依赖该地产的木材供应。尽管有其他木材来源，但木材是锯木厂必需的原材料。买方拒绝允许锯木厂继续从其购买的土地上采伐木材。

以下哪项是锯木厂主张采益权（profit）继续存在的最佳论据？

zh-choices.A: 由于锯木厂信赖该地产作为其木材来源，买方因禁反言而不得否认该采益权的存在。
zh-choices.B: 该采益权通过默示方式存在。
zh-choices.C: 该采益权是通过书面协议创设的。
zh-choices.D: 木材对于锯木厂的运营是必要的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Profits
核心考点：默示采益权 (Implied Profit)

本题考察的是采益权（Profit à prendre）在土地所有权合并（Merger）后如何通过“既有使用”（Prior Use）再次默示产生。

案情法律演变 (Legal Timeline)
阶段 1：明示授予
土地所有者书面授予锯木厂10年的采益权。此时存在有效的书面采益权。
阶段 2：混同 (Merger) !关键点
锯木厂买下了整块土地。当需役地和供役地归同一人所有时，原有的采益权因混同而消灭。书面合同失效。
阶段 3：分离 (Severance)
锯木厂卖掉了林地（供役地），保留了工厂用地（需役地）。此时没有新的书面协议。
为何选 B：基于既有使用的默示

虽然书面协议已死，但锯木厂可以主张Implied Profit from Prior Use（基于既有使用的默示采益权）。其构成要件与“准地役权”（Quasi-easement）完全一致：

  • 共同所有权的分离 (Severance of Common Ownership)：锯木厂曾拥有整块地，然后卖掉了一部分。
  • 既有使用 (Prior Existing Use)：在分离前，锯木厂一直在使用林地伐木以供应工厂。
  • 明显且持续 (Apparent and Continuous)：伐木行为是显而易见的，且持续进行。
  • 合理必要性 (Reasonable Necessity)：虽然不是绝对必要（有其他来源），但木材对工厂运营是重要的，且工厂已产生依赖，符合“合理必要”标准。
🚫 常见陷阱 (选项 C)：
考生常误选 C（书面协议），认为最初的10年合同仍然有效。

错误原因：根据混同原则 (Doctrine of Merger)，一旦锯木厂买下土地，它不能对自己拥有的土地持有采益权，因此原书面权利即刻消灭。之后再出售土地时，除非重新书面约定，否则原合同不会自动复活。

为何不选 A (Estoppel)： 禁反言通常需要买方（供役地所有人）做出了某种许可或陈述，导致锯木厂信赖。本题中买方直接拒绝，未给予许可。

为何不选 D (Necessity)： 1. 采益权通常不通过“必要性”（Necessity）创设。
2. 即使类比地役权，必要性地役权要求严格必要 (Strict Necessity)（如无路可走）。本题中有其他木材来源，不满足严格必要。

💡 MBE 策略总结
看到“权利人买下了供役地”的情节，第一反应必须是Merger（混同）——原权利消灭。

随后如果土地再次被分割（Severance），要寻找Implied Easement/Profit（默示权利）的线索，关键词是“Prior Use”（既有使用）和“Reasonable Necessity”（合理必要）。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Six years ago, a landlord and a tenant entered into a 10-year commercial lease of land. The written lease provided that if a public entity under the power of eminent domain condemned any part of the land but not all of it, the lease would terminate and the landlord would receive the entire condemnation award. Thereafter, the city condemned approximately two-thirds of the land.
The tenant notified the city and the landlord that an independent appraisal of the value of the tenant's possessory interest established that it substantially exceeded the tenant's obligation under the lease and that the tenant was entitled to share the award. The appraisal was accurate.
In an appropriate action among the landlord, the tenant, and the city as to the right of the tenant to a portion of the condemnation award, for whom will the court likely find?

choices.A: The landlord, because the condemnation superseded and canceled the lease.
choices.B: The landlord, because the parties specifically agreed as to the consequences of a partial condemnation.
choices.C: The tenant, because otherwise the landlord would be unjustly enriched.
choices.D: The tenant, because the landlord breached the landlord's implied warranty of quiet enjoyment.

questions.explanation:
Taking of leased property by eminent domain
Taking of all leased property for entire lease term
Yes No
Lease terminates
Tenant entitled to:
  • stop paying rent
  • share of condemnation award (fair market value + compensatory damages)
Taking significantly interferes with contemplated use
Yes No
Lease terminates
Tenant entitled to:
  • stop paying rent
  • share of condemnation award (fair market value + compensatory damages)
Lease continues
Tenant entitled to:
  • abate rent
  • share of condemnation award (fair market value + compensatory damages)

A taking of all or part of a leasehold under the power of eminent domain generally entitles the tenant to a share of the condemnation award. The tenant's share of the award is equal to the fair market value of the condemned leasehold plus any amount necessary to compensate the tenant for any continued obligation to pay rent that may be required under the lease.

However, the parties can expressly agree to alternative provisions in the lease, and courts will typically enforce those agreed-upon provisions. Here, the parties specifically agreed that a partial condemnation would terminate the lease and that the landlord would receive the entire condemnation award. Since the lease controls, the tenant is not entitled to any portion of the condemnation award.

(Choice A) The condemnation would have canceled the lease had the city condemned all the land for the entire lease term. Since the city condemned only two-thirds of the land, the lease was terminated in accordance with the landlord and tenant's lease agreement.

(Choice C) Although the landlord may be enriched by the condemnation award, it is not unjust because the parties agreed to the lease provision.

(Choice D) A landlord's implied warranty of quiet enjoyment provides that the tenant's possession and enjoyment of the leased premises will not be disturbed by the landlord or someone with superior title. The taking of leased land under the power of eminent domain does not breach this warranty because the condemnation occurred through no fault of the landlord.

📌 Educational Objective

Unless otherwise provided under a lease, a taking of all or part of a leasehold under the power of eminent domain entitles the tenant to a share of the condemnation award. The tenant's share is equal to the fair market value of the condemned leasehold plus compensation for any continued obligation to pay rent.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord and Tenant §§ 8.1–8.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977).
questions.zh-question:
六年前，一位出租人与一位承租人签订了一份为期10年的土地商业租赁合同。书面租约规定，如果公共实体根据 eminent domain (征用权) 征用土地的任何一部分而非全部，租约将终止，并且出租人将获得全部征用补偿金。此后，该市征用了大约三分之二的土地。

承租人通知市政府和出租人，一项对其占有权益价值的独立评估表明，其价值大大超过了租约规定的承租人义务，因此承租人有权分享该补偿金。该评估是准确的。

在出租人、承租人和市政府之间就承租人是否有权获得一部分征用补偿金而提起的适当诉讼中，法院可能会支持哪一方？

zh-choices.A: 出租人，因为征用取代并取消了租约。
zh-choices.B: 出租人，因为双方已就部分征用的后果作出了明确约定。
zh-choices.C: 承租人，因为否则出租人将构成不当得利。
zh-choices.D: 承租人，因为出租人违反了其默示的安宁管有保证。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Landlord-Tenant
核心考点：征用条款 (Condemnation Clause)
本题考察的是当政府行使征用权 (Eminent Domain) 时，租赁双方如何分配征用补偿金 (Condemnation Award) 的问题。
法律规则详解

1. 默认规则 (General Rule)：
如果没有特别约定，当租赁物业被全部或部分征用时，承租人(Tenant) 有权分享征用补偿金。承租人的份额通常等于其租赁权益的公平市场价值 (Fair Market Value of Leasehold) 超过其剩余租金义务的部分（即 Bonus Value）。

2. 契约自由 (Freedom of Contract)：
这是本题的关键。法律允许出租人(Landlord) 和承租人在租约中通过征用条款 (Condemnation Clause) 改变上述默认规则。

如果租约明确规定：

  • 征用发生时租约终止；且
  • 出租人获得全部 (Entire) 补偿金。
那么法院将严格执行该合同条款，承租人无权获得任何补偿。

正确答案：B

出租人胜诉，因为双方已就部分征用的后果作出了明确约定。

逻辑推演：

  1. 题目中明确指出租约包含一项条款：如果发生部分征用，租约终止，且出租人获得全部征用补偿金 (Entire condemnation award)。
  2. 虽然承租人的租赁权益经评估确实有价值（Appraisal was accurate），但在合同法原则下，双方明确签署的条款优先于普通法的默认分配规则。
  3. 承租人自愿放弃了其在征用赔偿中的潜在份额。
干扰项排除
选项 A (错误)：
虽然部分征用导致了租约终止，但这并不是因为征用行为本身“自动”取消了租约，而是因为租约中的条款规定了终止。如果是普通法下的部分征用，通常租约不会终止，承租人只是获得租金减免。
选项 C (错误)：
不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment) 是一种衡平法救济，通常仅在没有有效合同管辖该事项时适用。既然双方有明确的书面租约规定了资金分配，就不存在“不当”得利。
选项 D (错误)：
安宁管有保证 (Implied Warranty of Quiet Enjoyment) 针对的是出租人或拥有更优所有权之人的干扰。政府行使主权权力（征用）属于不可抗力或第三方行为，并非出租人的违约行为。
💡 MBE 解题技巧

在处理 Landlord-Tenant 问题时，永远先看租约 (Lease) 是否有特定条款。

虽然普通法倾向于保护承租人在征用中的权益，但 MBE 经常测试“合同条款优先” (Contract Controls) 的原则。只要条款不违法，法院会优先执行双方的约定，而不是默认规则。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A developer and a commercial real estate investment group own adjoining lots near a city's downtown. The developer decided to raze the existing building on its lot and erect an office building of greater height. The developer received all governmental approvals required to pursue the project and no statute or ordinance applies (other than those dealing with various approvals for zoning, building, etc.).
When the building was completed, the investment group discovered that the substantial shadow cast by the developer's new building diminished its ability to lease apartments, substantially lowered the rent it could charge, and greatly reduced the apartment complex's overall occupancy rate. Assume that these facts are proved in an appropriate action the investment group instituted against the developer for all and any relief available.
Which of the following is the most appropriate comment concerning this lawsuit?

choices.A: Judgment should be for the developer, because the investment group has no cause of action.
choices.B: The investment group is entitled to a mandatory injunction requiring the developer to restore conditions to those existing with the prior building insofar as the shadow is concerned.
choices.C: The court should award damages for losses suffered to the date of trial and leave open recovery of future damages.
choices.D: The court should award permanent damages, in lieu of an injunction, equal to the present value of all rents lost and loss on rents for the reasonable life of the apartment complex.

questions.explanation:
Available negative easements
Common law Modern view
  • Light
  • Air
  • Support
  • Water access
  • View
  • Solar access
  • Conservation

The Doctrine of Ancient Lights is an English common law doctrine that enabled landowners to prevent their neighbors from constructing buildings or other structures that blocked their access to sunlight. This doctrine has been rejected in every jurisdiction, so landowners can only restrict another's blockage of light—or other lawful use of their own land—through a negative easement (ie, restrictive covenant). This type of easement can only be created by express written agreement.

Here, the developer's new building casts a substantial shadow over the investment group's apartment complex. But the developer received all necessary governmental approvals to pursue its project and there is no applicable statute. Additionally, there is no indication that the investment group obtained a negative easement or covenant from the developer that would prevent it from blocking the sunlight. Therefore, judgment should be for the developer because the investment group has no cause of action.

(Choices B, C & D) Had the investment group obtained a negative easement, it would have been entitled to an injunction and/or damages. Courts consider several factors in determining the appropriate remedy but tend to issue an injunction for breach of a negative easement. That is because the easement holder is denied the benefit of the easement—ie, the ability to restrict another's lawful use of their own land—if only damages are issued.

📌 Educational Objective

A landowner can only restrict another's lawful use of their own land by obtaining a negative easement (ie, restrictive covenant). And negative easements can only be created by express written agreement.

📚 References
  • Mohr v. Midas Realty Corp., 431 N.W.2d 380, 382 (Iowa 1988) (explaining that every state has rejected the Doctrine of Ancient Lights).
questions.zh-question:
一个开发商和一个商业房地产投资集团在市中心附近拥有相邻地块。该开发商决定拆除其地块上的现有建筑，并建造一座更高的办公楼。该开发商获得了项目所需的所有政府批准，并且没有适用的法规或条例（除了那些处理分区、建筑等各种批准的法规或条例）。

当大楼建成后，该投资集团发现，开发商的新建大楼投下的巨大阴影削弱了其出租公寓的能力，大幅降低了其可收取的租金，并大大降低了公寓大楼的整体入住率。假设这些事实在投资集团对开发商提起的、寻求所有及任何可用救济的适当诉讼中得到证实。

关于这起诉讼，以下哪项评论最为恰当？

zh-choices.A: 判决应有利于开发商，因为投资集团没有诉因。
zh-choices.B: 投资集团有权获得强制性禁令，要求开发商就阴影问题将状况恢复到先前建筑存在时的状态。
zh-choices.C: 法院应就截至审判之日所遭受的损失判给损害赔偿，并对未来损害赔偿的追偿持开放态度。
zh-choices.D: 法院应判给永久性损害赔偿，以代替禁令，其金额应等于在公寓大楼的合理使用年限内所有租金损失和租金减损的现值。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析

Real Property: Rights in Land
正确答案：A 判决应有利于开发商，因为投资集团没有诉因 (Cause of Action)。
核心考点：采光权 (Rights to Light)

在美国财产法中，土地所有者没有获得阳光、空气或景观穿过邻居土地的自然权利。

邻居
(原告)
开发商
(被告)

要限制邻居阻挡光线，必须拥有消极地役权 (Negative Easement)。

法律推理分析

1. 拒绝 "Doctrine of Ancient Lights"

英国普通法曾有一项原则叫 Doctrine of Ancient Lights（古代采光权原则），即如果一个人长期使用窗户采光（通常是20年），他就通过时效取得了采光权。但是，美国所有司法管辖区都拒绝了这一原则。

2. 消极地役权的设立要求

在美国，采光权属于消极地役权。消极地役权只能通过明确的书面协议 (Express Grant/Writing) 设立，不能通过暗示 (Implication) 或时效 (Prescription) 获得。

3. 本案应用

  • 开发商行为合法 (Lawful use)。
  • 获得了所有政府批准。
  • 双方没有签署任何关于采光的限制性契约。

因此，尽管投资集团遭受了经济损失，但这属于 Damnum Absque Injuria（无违法行为的损害），法律不予救济。

排除干扰项

选项 B (禁令)、C (当前损害赔偿)、D (永久损害赔偿) 都是具体的救济措施 (Remedies)。

只有在确定被告有责任 (Liability) 的前提下，法院才会讨论救济措施。既然开发商没有侵犯任何法律权利（没有违反地役权，也没有构成妨害），原告就没有任何诉因，因此不需要讨论赔偿或禁令。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
The owner of a five-acre parcel of land constructed a house on the land. The following year, the owner installed an underground drainage system on the land in order to prevent future flooding of his house.
Several years later, the owner gave one acre of the land in fee simple to his niece. The deed contained a provision in which the niece promised that she and her heirs and assigns would maintain the portion of the drainage system on her one acre. This deed was not recorded.
Five years later, the niece sold her one acre, in fee simple, at its fair market value to a buyer. Although the niece informed the buyer of her promise with regard to the drainage system, the deed by which the niece conveyed her property to the buyer did not mention this promise. The buyer promptly recorded this deed. Ten months later, there was a severe rainstorm. Because of the buyer's failure to maintain the drainage system, the owner's house flooded. The owner has sued the buyer for damages resulting from this failure.
A statute in the applicable jurisdiction provides, "No conveyance of an interest in real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value unless the same be first recorded according to law."
Should the court enforce the niece's promise against the buyer?

choices.A: No, because the deed by which the owner conveyed the one acre to his niece was not recorded.
choices.B: No, because the doctrine of estoppel by deed does not apply here.
choices.C: Yes, because both horizontal and vertical privity exist.
choices.D: Yes, because the buyer learned of the promise from the niece herself.

questions.explanation:
Privity Requirements for Real Covenants

Between promising parties
Promising party
(benefited estate)
Contract law

(benefited estate)

(burdened estate)

Successor in interest
Vertical
Successor in interest

A real covenant is an express promise to do (affirmative) or not do (negative/restrictive) something on land enforceable by an action for damages. While the promising parties are bound by contract law, the covenant binds successors in interest only if it runs with the land. The elements required for a real covenant to run with the land are:

  • Writing: The covenant must satisfy the statute of frauds (e.g., the deed from the owner to his niece).
  • Intent to run: The promising parties intended for the covenant to run to successors (e.g., the deed says “heirs and assigns”).
  • Touch and concern: The covenant relates to the use, enjoyment, or occupation of the estates (e.g., maintaining a drainage system).
  • Horizontal privity: The promising parties simultaneously transferred the land and created the covenant (e.g., the covenant was created when a parcel was deeded).
  • Vertical privity: The successor of the burdened estate has the promising party’s entire estate (e.g., the buyer), OR the successor of the benefited estate has a possessory interest (Choice C).
  • Notice: The person to be bound had notice of the covenant (e.g., the buyer learned of the promise from the niece) (Choice D).

In this scenario, the covenant did run with the land, but the buyer is not subject to it because of the pure race jurisdiction. Under a pure race recording act, a real property interest cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser who recorded first. Since the buyer’s deed (which lacked the covenant) was recorded before the deed creating the covenant (from the owner to the niece), the promise is unenforceable against the buyer.

Note: An injunction to enforce a covenant is called an equitable servitude.

(Choice B) Estoppel by deed prevents a grantor from denying the effectiveness of a warranty deed that the grantor issued before the grantor actually owned the land. That doctrine does not apply here.

📌 Educational Objective

Under a race recording act, a real property interest cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser who records first.

📚 References
  • Restatement of Property §§ 530–38 (Am. Law Inst. 1944)
questions.zh-question:
一块五英亩土地的所有者在该土地上建造了一栋房屋。次年，为了防止房屋未来遭受洪水侵袭，该所有者在土地上安装了地下排水系统。

几年后，该所有者将其中一英亩的土地以fee simple（绝对所有权）的形式赠与了他的侄女。契据中包含一项条款，侄女承诺她及其继承人和受让人将维护其一英亩土地上的那部分排水系统。该契据未进行登记。

五年后，侄女以公平市价将其一英亩土地以fee simple（绝对所有权）的形式出售给一位买方。尽管侄女告知了买方她关于排水系统的承诺，但侄女转让其财产给买方的契据中并未提及此承诺。买方立即登记了该契据。十个月后，发生了一场特大暴雨。由于买方未能维护排水系统，导致所有者的房屋被淹。所有者已起诉买方，要求其赔偿因未履行维护义务而造成的损失。

适用法域的一项法规规定，“任何不动产权益的转让，除非首先依法登记，否则对有偿的后手购买人无效。”

法院是否应强制买方履行侄女的承诺？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为所有者转让一英亩土地给其侄女的契据未进行登记。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为estoppel by deed（契据禁止反言）原则在此不适用。
zh-choices.C: 应，因为同时存在横向和纵向的利害关系（privity）。
zh-choices.D: 应，因为买方从侄女本人处得知了该承诺。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析：不动产登记法

正确答案：A

本题的核心考点在于识别并应用“纯粹抢先登记法” (Pure Race Statute)，以及理解它如何切断未登记的地产契约 (Real Covenant)。

1. 识别关键法规 (The Statute)

解题的第一步是分析题目中给出的法规文本。这是决定胜负的关键：

"No conveyance... shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value unless the same be first recorded according to law."
法规类型分析

该法规只提到了“首先登记 (first recorded)”，而没有提到“善意 (good faith)”或“无通知 (without notice)”。

👉 这是一个 Race Statute (抢先登记法)。

2. 法律逻辑推演

在 Race Statute 管辖区，规则非常简单粗暴：谁先登记，谁就赢。购买时的知情情况 (Notice) 是无关紧要的。

  • 权益冲突：所有者 (Owner) 试图执行 Deed 1 中的契约（维护排水系统）。
  • Deed 1 (Owner → Niece)：设立了该契约，但从未登记。
  • Deed 2 (Niece → Buyer)：买方支付了对价 (Purchaser for value)，且立即登记了。

结论：由于买方 (Buyer) 首先登记了 Deed 2，而包含契约的 Deed 1 未被登记，根据法规，Deed 1 对买方无效。因此，买方不受该契约约束。

3. 为什么其他选项是陷阱？
❌ 选项 C & D (最大的干扰项)

这两个选项都在讨论地产契约随土地转移 (Covenant Running with the Land) 的普通法要素：

  • 选项 C 提到了 Privity (利害关系)。
  • 选项 D 提到了 Notice (通知/知情)。

陷阱分析：虽然在普通法下，买方有 Actual Notice (实际知情) 通常会让契约对他生效，但在登记法 (Recording Acts) 面前，这些规则必须退让。

题目特意强调“买方知道承诺”，就是为了诱导你选择 D。但在 Race Jurisdiction（抢先登记法域），知情 (Notice) 是不相关的。只要买方先登记，哪怕他完全知道之前的权益存在，他依然胜诉。

❌ 选项 B (Estoppel by Deed)

Estoppel by deed (契据禁止反言) 适用于转让人在没有产权时就转让土地，后来获得产权的情况。这与本案事实完全无关。

4. 考试技巧总结 (Exam Tip)

在处理 MBE 不动产题目时，请遵循以下流程：

  1. 看法规：首先判断是 Race, Notice 还是 Race-Notice 法规。
    • Race: "first recorded"
    • Notice: "without notice/good faith"
    • Race-Notice: "without notice" AND "first recorded"
  2. 看时间轴：谁先登记？谁是后续购买人？
  3. 应用规则：如果是 Race Statute，直接忽略“知情 (Notice)”这一事实。
MBE Real Property Review
Focus: Recording Acts & Covenants

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A rancher whose land borders a stream used it to water his livestock. The owner of a small waterpark, in existence before the ranch, was located upstream of the rancher's land. The water park required a significant amount of water in order to function properly, so the owner diverted almost all of the stream water into the water park. No longer able to adequately water his livestock from the stream, the rancher filed an action against the owner.
In a jurisdiction that recognizes the riparian doctrine with regard to water usage, who will prevail?

choices.A: The owner, because he made reasonable use of the water.
choices.B: The owner, because his use of water has priority as he was on the land first.
choices.C: The rancher, because he made beneficial use of the water.
choices.D: The rancher, because the owner's commercial use of the water unreasonably interfered with the rancher's domestic use.

questions.explanation:
Water rights doctrines
Riparian doctrine (eastern states)
  • Water belongs to owners of adjoining land
  • Reasonable use that does not unreasonably interfere with downstream use permitted (reasonable-use doctrine)
  • Domestic use trumps commercial use
  • Water rights cannot be sold or transferred separate from adjoining land
Prior-appropriation doctrine (western states)
  • Water rights determined by priority of beneficial use ("first in time, first in right")
  • Water rights are unconnected to adjoining land & can be sold or transferred separately

Eastern states favor the riparian doctrine, under which water rights belong to "riparians," or landowners whose property borders a body of water. Riparians can make any reasonable use of the water that does not unreasonably interfere with downstream use. Domestic ("natural") use trumps commercial ("artificial") use.

Here, the rancher used the water to water his livestock, which is a domestic use, while the owner used the water to operate a water park, which is a commercial use. Because the owner's use likely prevented the rancher from watering his livestock, the owner's use was likely unreasonable and thus interfered with the rancher's downstream use (Choice A).

*This is known as the reasonable-use doctrine.*

(Choices B & C) Western states follow the prior-appropriation doctrine, which is not applicable here. Under this doctrine, water rights are determined by priority of beneficial use under the "first in time, first in right" rule.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the riparian doctrine, water rights belong to riparians who can make reasonable use that does not unreasonably interfere with downstream use, and domestic use trumps commercial use.

📚 References
  • 78 Am. Jur. 2d Waters §§ 35, 37 (2020) (riparian rights generally and requirement for reasonable use).
questions.zh-question:
一个牧场主的土地与一条溪流接壤，他用这条溪流给他的牲畜饮水。一个小型水上乐园的所有者，在牧场存在之前就已存在，位于牧场主土地的上游。该水上乐园需要大量的水才能正常运作，因此所有者将几乎所有的溪水都引流到了水上乐园。由于无法再从溪流中为他的牲畜提供足够的水，牧场主对该所有者提起了诉讼。

在一个承认关于水资源使用的 riparian doctrine（河岸权原则）的司法管辖区，谁将胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 乐园所有者，因为他对水的使用是合理的。
zh-choices.B: 乐园所有者，因为他先于牧场主使用土地，所以他的用水有优先权。
zh-choices.C: 牧场主，因为他对水进行了有益使用。
zh-choices.D: 牧场主，因为乐园所有者对水的商业性使用不合理地干扰了牧场主的家庭性使用。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Water Rights
核心考点：河岸权原则 (Riparian Doctrine)

本题考查的是美国水权法中的河岸权原则 (Riparian Doctrine)，该原则主要通行于美国东部各州。

根据该原则，水权属于拥有与水道接壤土地的人（Riparians）。核心规则是合理使用原则 (Reasonable Use Doctrine)。

在 Riparian Doctrine 下，对水的使用被分为两类，且存在明确的优先级：

使用类型 定义与示例 优先级
自然/家庭使用
(Natural/Domestic)		 为了维持生存或家庭日常需要。
例：饮用、园艺、给自家牲畜饮水。		 最高优先级
甚至可以为了满足此需求而耗尽水源。
人工/商业使用
(Artificial/Commercial)		 为了盈利或生产。
例：灌溉农场、工业制造、水上乐园。		 次级优先级
不得无理干扰下游的自然使用。

案情应用

在本案中，我们需要界定双方的使用性质：

  • 牧场主 (Rancher)：给牲畜饮水。这通常被归类为家庭/自然使用 (Domestic/Natural Use)。
  • 乐园所有者 (Owner)：经营水上乐园。这是典型的商业/人工使用 (Commercial/Artificial Use)。

冲突点：上游的商业使用（人工）几乎耗尽了水源，导致下游的家庭使用（自然）无法满足。

✅ 正确答案：D

理由：在河岸权原则下，家庭性（自然）使用优先于商业性（人工）使用。

乐园所有者的商业用水虽然可能对其业务是“有益的”，但当它干扰了下游牧场主的家庭性用水（牲畜饮水）时，这种干扰被视为不合理的 (Unreasonable)。因此，牧场主胜诉。
⚠️ 常见陷阱：选项 B (Prior Appropriation)

选项 B 提到了“先到先得” (First in time, first in right)。这是美国西部州通行的先占原则 (Prior Appropriation Doctrine)。

题目明确指出该司法管辖区适用 Riparian Doctrine。在河岸权原则下，先来后到并不产生优先权。无论谁先在土地上，所有河岸权人的权利是平等的，仅受“合理使用”限制。

❌ 选项 A 错误： 耗尽水源导致下游无法进行家庭使用，这在法律上被视为“不合理使用”。
❌ 选项 C 错误： 虽然牧场主确实进行了“有益使用”，但他胜诉的根本法律依据是“家庭使用优先于商业使用”的层级关系，而非仅仅因为使用了水。
💡 MBE 解题技巧
看到水权题目，第一步先看适用哪个原则：
  • Riparian (东部)： 关键词是“合理使用 (Reasonable Use)”和“土地接壤”。家庭 > 商业。
  • Prior Appropriation (西部)： 关键词是“先占先得 (First in time)”和“有益使用 (Beneficial Use)”。与是否拥有河岸土地无关。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man and his neighbor owned homes on adjacent lots in a subdivision. The subdivision's recorded restrictions did not prohibit detached storage sheds, and several homeowners in the subdivision had placed such sheds in their backyards. Because the man and the neighbor thought the sheds were unsightly, they both agreed in writing not to place detached storage sheds in their respective yards. Their agreement was drafted in recordable form and stated that it was enforceable by and against all assignees, heirs, and successors. The agreement was promptly recorded.
Three years later, the neighbor gave his home to his daughter. Shortly after moving into the home, the daughter learned of the restriction. She informed the man that she planned to put a detached storage shed in her backyard, claiming that the restriction was not enforceable against her.
Does the man have the right to enjoin the neighbor's daughter from placing a detached storage shed in her yard?

choices.A: No, because several homeowners in the subdivision have storage sheds in their yards.
choices.B: No, because there was no horizontal privity between the man and the neighbor.
choices.C: Yes, because the neighbor conveyed the home to the daughter by gift rather than by sale.
choices.D: Yes, because the restriction is binding on the daughter as a successor.

questions.explanation:
Elements of real covenants & equitable servitudes

Real covenants
(enforceable by money damages)		 Equitable servitudes
(enforceable by equitable relief)
For burden to run For benefit to run Express Implied
  • Writing
  • Intent to run
  • Touch & concern
  • Horizontal & vertical privity
  • Notice
  • Writing
  • Intent to run
  • Touch & concern
  • Limited vertical privity
  • No notice required
  • Writing
  • Intent to run
  • Touch & concern
  • Notice
  • Intent to create common scheme
  • Restrictive servitude
  • Notice

An equitable servitude is a nonpossessory interest in land that is enforceable in equity (e.g., by injunction) rather than by an action for money damages at law.

Elements of Express Equitable Servitude:

  • Writing: Here, the man and the neighbor entered into a written agreement.
  • Intent to run: The agreement stated that it was enforceable by and against all assignees, heirs, and successors.
  • Touch and concern: The agreement prohibited detached storage sheds in the yards of the homes. The restriction touches and concerns both the dominant and servient estates because it relates to the landowners' use and enjoyment of their respective properties.
  • Notice: The daughter, as a successor in interest to the neighbor's property, had notice of the restriction.

Therefore, the agreement is a valid equitable servitude, and the man can enjoin the daughter from building a detached storage shed in her yard. (Choice D)

(Choice A) is incorrect because the fact that several other homeowners in the subdivision have storage sheds in their yards does not prevent the man from enforcing the restriction against the daughter. Those other homeowners are not parties to the agreement between the man and the neighbor and are not bound by it.

(Choice B) is incorrect because privity is required for real covenants, not for equitable servitudes. Horizontal privity between the man and the neighbor is therefore not required here.

(Choice C) is incorrect because the fact that the neighbor conveyed the home to the daughter by gift rather than by sale does not change the outcome. The restriction runs with the land and binds successors regardless of whether they acquire title by gift or purchase.

*Note that even if the daughter had purchased the home rather than receiving it by gift, she had record notice of the restriction.

📌 Educational Objective

To understand the four elements required to create an express equitable servitude: (1) writing, (2) intent to run, (3) touch and concern, and (4) notice for a purchaser.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 5.1 (Am. L. Inst. 2000)
  • Restatement of Property § 539 (Am. L. Inst. 1944)
questions.zh-question:
一名男子和他的邻居在一个小区里拥有相邻地块上的房屋。该小区的已登记限制并未禁止建造独立储物棚，并且小区内的几位业主已在自家后院放置了此类储物棚。由于该男子和邻居认为储物棚不美观，他们双方书面同意不在各自的院子里放置独立储物棚。他们的协议以可登记的形式起草，并声明该协议对其所有受让人、继承人和继任者均具有约束力并可强制执行。该协议被及时登记。

三年后，邻居将他的房屋赠与了他的女儿。搬进房屋后不久，女儿得知了这项限制。她告知该男子，她计划在自家后院放置一个独立储物棚，并声称该限制对她不具有强制执行力。

该男子是否有权禁止邻居的女儿在其院子里放置独立储物棚？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为小区内的几位业主在他们的院子里有储物棚。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该男子和邻居之间没有横向当事人关系。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为邻居是通过赠与而非买卖的方式将房屋转让给女儿的。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为女儿作为继任者，受该限制的约束。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Servitudes

Topic: Equitable Servitudes
正确答案：D

是的，因为该限制作为一项衡平法地役权（Equitable Servitude），对作为继任者的女儿具有约束力。

核心考点：救济方式决定法律适用

本题的关键在于原告寻求的救济方式（Remedy）：

  • 如果原告要求金钱赔偿（Money Damages），则适用地产约据（Real Covenant）的规则。
  • 如果原告要求禁令（Injunction）（如本题），则适用衡平法地役权（Equitable Servitude）的规则。

由于本题中男子寻求的是禁止令（Enjoin），我们只需要分析是否满足衡平法地役权的要素。

衡平法地役权的要素 (WITN)

要使负担（Burden）随土地转移并约束继任者，必须满足以下四个要素：

1. 书面形式 (Writing)
原初的协议是书面的，并符合《反欺诈法》（Statute of Frauds）。
2. 意图 (Intent)
协议中明确声明对“所有受让人、继承人和继任者”具有约束力。
3. 涉及和关系到土地 (Touch and Concern)
该限制（禁止建储物棚）直接影响了土地的使用和价值，限制了业主对自己土地的权利。
4. 通知 (Notice)
这是关键。继任者必须在取得土地时对该限制知情。因为协议已被登记（Recorded），女儿具有推定通知/登记通知（Record/Constructive Notice）。

本题中，所有要素均已满足，因此该限制对女儿有效。

易错点辨析：为何不需要 Privity？

很多考生会纠结于选项 B（横向当事人关系/Horizontal Privity）。这是 MBE 常见的陷阱。

比较项目 地产约据
(Real Covenant)		 衡平法地役权
(Equitable Servitude)
救济方式 金钱赔偿 (Damages) 禁令 (Injunction)
横向当事人关系
(Horizontal Privity)		 必须具备 不需要
纵向当事人关系
(Vertical Privity)		 严格要求 通常不需要 (或要求很低)

选项 B 错误的原因： 虽然邻居之间最初只是相邻关系，可能缺乏横向当事人关系（Horizontal Privity），但这只在男子索赔金钱时才成为障碍。对于禁令（Injunction），衡平法不要求横向当事人关系。

其他选项解析
  • 选项 A (其他业主)： 错误。这是一份两个邻居之间的私人协议，而非整个小区的共同规划（Common Scheme）。其他业主没有签署该协议，因此不受约束，但这不影响协议签署方及其继任者之间的约束力。
  • 选项 C (赠与 vs 买卖)： 错误。只要有通知（Notice），负担就会随土地转移。登记（Recording）确立了通知，无论继任者是通过购买还是赠与获得土地。
MBE Property Law Strategy: Always check the remedy sought first!

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner leased a plot of land to a bamboo farmer on a month-to-month basis, with rent due at the beginning of each month. The farmer planted dwarf bamboo crops on the land. For several years thereafter, the farmer would divide the roots of each bamboo plant and replant them on the land in early spring. Each October, the farmer would harvest some of the plants to sell to local landscapers.
On October 31, the farmer paid rent to the landowner, at which time the landowner notified the farmer that the lease would terminate as of November 30 because the landowner had sold the land to a large farming corporation. Although harvesting season was over, the farmer attempted to reenter the land on December 15 and remove the remaining bamboo plants.
The landowner filed suit against the farmer to prevent the removal of the plants.
In whose favor should the court rule?

choices.A: The farmer, because all emblements remain personal property.
choices.B: The farmer, because the farmer planted the bamboo and the lease was for an indefinite duration.
choices.C: The landowner, because the farmer had already harvested the bamboo plants.
choices.D: The landowner, because the owner of the land is irrebuttably presumed to be the owner of the crops.

questions.explanation:
Ownership of emblements
Type Status Upon transfer of land
Planted, cultivated crops (fructus industriales) Personal property Pass with land except* when:
  • harvested — severed from land
  • ripe — mature (some courts)
  • planted by tenant with indefinite leasehold or
  • planted by adverse possessor under claim of right
Wild, uncultivated crops (fructus naturales) Part of real property Pass automatically with land
*Then prior owner has right to reenter land to remove crops.

There are two types of emblements (ie, crops) that are generally conveyed with the land:

  • Fructus industriales – produced through cultivation and considered personal property
  • Fructus naturales – occur naturally (ie, without human assistance) and considered real property

Landowners are generally presumed to own the crops on their land and to convey them with the land upon sale. However, the doctrine of emblements applies when a lease of uncertain duration is terminated through no fault of the tenant. In such cases, the tenant has the right to reenter the land to remove, harvest, or cultivate crops that the tenant planted during the tenancy.

Here, a farmer planted bamboo (fructus industriales) on a month-to-month lease that was held indefinitely. Because the landlord terminated the lease to sell the land (through no fault of the farmer), the farmer has the right to reenter the land under the doctrine of emblements. Therefore, the court should rule in favor of the farmer.

(Choice A) Fructus industriales are personal property, while fructus naturales are real property. Therefore, not all emblements remain personal property.

(Choice C) Even if some of the bamboo was harvested, the farmer can still reenter the land to harvest the rest under the doctrine of emblements.

(Choice D) The presumption that the landowner owns the crops is not irrebuttable and can be rebutted by evidence of contrary intent.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the doctrine of emblements, a tenant can reenter land to harvest crops planted during a tenancy if the lease was of uncertain duration and terminated through no fault of the tenant.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 12.3 cmt. h (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (harvesting agricultural crops from leased property).
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者按月将一块土地出租给一位竹农，租金在每月初支付。该农民在土地上种植了矮竹作物。此后的几年里，该农民会在早春时节将每株竹子的根部分开，并重新种植在土地上。每年十月，农民会收割部分竹子卖给当地的园艺师。

10月31日，农民向土地所有者支付了租金，当时土地所有者通知农民，由于他已将土地出售给一家大型农业公司，租约将于11月30日终止。尽管收获季节已过，农民仍试图在12月15日重新进入该土地，并移走剩余的竹子。

土地所有者对农民提起诉讼，以阻止其移走这些植物。

法院应作出对谁有利的裁决？

zh-choices.A: 农民，因为fructus industriales被视为动产。
zh-choices.B: 农民，因为“emblements”原则（庄稼收益权）赋予他移走竹子的权利。
zh-choices.C: 土地所有者，因为农民已经收割了竹子。
zh-choices.D: 土地所有者，因为土地的所有者被推定为作物的所有者。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Landlord & Tenant

本题考察的核心法律原则是 Doctrine of Emblements（庄稼收益权原则）。

核心概念：作物分类
类型 Fructus Naturales
(天然作物)		 Fructus Industriales
(需耕种作物)
定义 自然生长，无需每年耕种（如多年生树木、野草）。 通过人类劳动每年种植或培育的作物（如玉米、小麦）。
性质 不动产 (Real Property) 动产 (Personal Property)

本案情况： 题目特别强调农民每年“分根并重新种植”竹子，这表明这些竹子属于 Fructus Industriales（需耕种作物）。

⚖️ 法律规则：Doctrine of Emblements

通常情况下，租约终止时，土地上的作物归地主所有。但是，为了保护农民的劳动成果，法律设立了“庄稼收益权”例外。

租户有权在租约结束后重返土地收割作物，必须满足以下三个条件：

✔
租期不确定 (Uncertain Duration)：
例如按月租赁 (Periodic Tenancy) 或 随意租赁 (Tenancy at Will)。
✔
非因租户过错终止 (No Fault)：
租约终止不是因为租户违约或主动退租。
✔
作物已种植：
作物必须是在租约终止前已经种下的。

📝 案情分析

让我们将规则应用到本题事实中：

  • 租约类型：按月租赁 (Month-to-month)，属于期限不确定。
  • 终止原因：地主卖地通知终止，非农民过错。
  • 作物状态：竹子是需耕种作物 (fructus industriales)，且已在终止前种下。

结论： 农民完全符合 Doctrine of Emblements 的条件，因此有权在租约结束后进入土地移走竹子。

🔍 选项解析

正确答案 B

农民胜诉，因为 Emblements 原则赋予他移走竹子的权利。

这是最准确的法律依据。该原则专门解决此类因租约意外终止而导致的作物归属问题。

选项 A 错误

虽然 fructus industriales 确实被视为动产 (Personalty)，但这本身不足以赋予租户在租约结束后进入土地的权利。如果租约是因租户违约而终止，即使作物是动产，租户也可能失去收割权。选项 B 提供了具体的法律权利来源。

选项 C 错误

农民是否已经收割了“部分”竹子与剩余竹子的归属无关。Emblements 原则保护的是那些尚未收割的劳动成果。

选项 D 错误

这是一般原则（地主拥有土地上的作物），但本题考查的是该原则的例外情况（Emblements）。在MBE考试中，如果事实触发了例外情形，必须优先适用例外。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
当看到涉及“农业租赁”、“作物”和“租约突然终止”的题目时，立即联想 Doctrine of Emblements。

关键判断点： 1. 是人工种植的吗？(Yes) 2. 租期是不确定的吗？(Yes) 3. 终止是地主造成的吗？(Yes)
如果全为 Yes，租户赢。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner's driveway separated her property from that of her neighbor. Although the neighbor could access his property from the other side, he also wanted the ability to enter his property on the side that ran parallel to the driveway. He asked the landowner for permission to do so, and the landowner granted the neighbor an easement to use her driveway in order to access his property for a period of 20 years. Two years later, the landowner decided to build a fence at the entrance to the driveway. After it was built, the landowner locked the fence and did not give a key to the neighbor despite his requests for one. Twelve years later, the landowner took the fence down. The neighbor attempted to use the driveway, but the landowner prevented him from doing so, claiming that he no longer had the right to use it.
The period of time to acquire rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
Does the neighbor still have the right to use the landowner's driveway?

choices.A: No, because the easement was terminated by estoppel.
choices.B: No, because the landowner prevented the neighbor from using the easement for the prescriptive period.
choices.C: Yes, because the neighbor did not act in an affirmative way to show a clear intent to relinquish his easement right.
choices.D: Yes, because the neighbor was granted an easement for a term of years, which has not expired.

questions.explanation:
Ways to terminate easements
  • Destruction – servient estate condemned or destroyed by natural forces
  • Abandonment – dominant estate abandons easement
  • Merger – dominant & servient estates united in common ownership
  • Prescription – servient owner prevents use for prescriptive period
  • Estoppel – dominant owner estopped from asserting easement
  • Release – express release in writing satisfying statute of frauds

Mnemonic: DAMPER

An easement is a nonpossessory right to use another person's land for a specific purpose. Just as an easement can be created by prescription, an easement can be terminated by prescription. Termination by prescription requires activity by the servient estate owner that is hostile and adverse, open and notorious (i.e., visible), and continued without interruption for the statutory period.

In this question, the landowner built a fence across the neighbor's driveway easement and kept the fence locked, thereby preventing the neighbor from using the easement for longer than the 10-year statutory prescriptive period. Under these circumstances, the easement was terminated by prescription. Accordingly, the neighbor does not have the right to use the driveway easement.

(Choice A) An easement may be terminated by estoppel if the dominant estate owner reasonably relied on the servient estate owner's conduct to his detriment. Here, there is no indication that the neighbor relied on any conduct of the landowner in a way that would estop the landowner from denying the easement.

(Choice C) An easement may be terminated by abandonment if the dominant estate owner acts in an affirmative way to show a clear intent to relinquish the easement right. Mere nonuse of an easement, without more, is insufficient to show abandonment.

(Choice D) Even if an easement is granted for a term of years (here, 20 years), the easement may still be terminated by prescription before the term expires if the servient estate owner prevents use of the easement for the statutory prescriptive period.

📌 Educational Objective

Understand that termination of an easement by prescription requires the servient-estate owner to act inconsistently with the easement in a manner that is hostile, adverse, open, notorious, and uninterrupted for the statutory period.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.7 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination of an easement by prescription).
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有人的车道将其地产与邻居的地产隔开。虽然邻居可以从另一侧进入其地产，但他也希望能够从与车道平行的那一侧进入。他请求土地所有人允许其这样做，土地所有人授予邻居一项地役权，允许其使用她的车道以进入其地产，期限为20年。两年后，土地所有人决定在车道入口处修建一个栅栏。建成后，土地所有人锁上了栅栏，并且尽管邻居索要，也未给他钥匙。十二年后，土地所有人拆除了栅栏。邻居试图使用该车道，但土地所有人阻止了他，声称他已不再有权使用该车道。

在该司法管辖区，通过时效取得权利的法定时效期间为10年。

邻居是否仍有权使用土地所有人的车道？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为该地役权已因禁止反言而终止。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该地役权已因时效而终止。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为土地所有人在车道入口修建栅栏的行为不具有敌意性质。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为授予邻居的是一个有固定期限的地役权，而该期限尚未届满。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：地役权的终止
正确答案：B (No, terminated by prescription)

本题考察的核心知识点是地役权的因时效终止 (Termination by Prescription)。

法律规则 (Rule):
就像可以通过时效取得 (Adverse Possession) 土地所有权一样，供役地所有人 (Servient Owner) 也可以通过满足类似的条件来终止地役权。

要件：供役地所有人对地役权的干涉必须是：
  • 敌意的 (Hostile/Adverse)：未经许可。
  • 公开且众所周知的 (Open and Notorious)：地役权人能够发现。
  • 持续的 (Continuous)：在法定时效期间内未中断。
📅 案件时间轴分析
第 0 年：地役权设立，期限 20 年。
(正常应持续到第 20 年)
第 2 年：土地所有人建起栅栏并上锁，拒绝给钥匙。
👉 敌意干扰开始，时效起算。
第 12 年：时效期间届满 (10年)。
(干扰持续了 12 - 2 = 10 年)
地役权在此刻彻底消灭
第 14 年 (当前)：栅栏被拆除。
但权利已消灭，无法自动恢复。
⚖️ 深度解析

1. 为什么是时效终止？
土地所有人 (Landowner) 建造栅栏并上锁的行为完全阻断了邻居的使用。这是一种实质性的干扰。这种干扰是公开的（看得见栅栏）、敌意的（拒绝给钥匙）、并且持续了12年。由于该司法管辖区的时效期是10年，在干扰持续满10年那一刻，地役权就在法律上被消灭了。

2. 为什么选项 D (20年期限) 是错误的？
这是本题最大的陷阱。虽然地役权原本设定为20年 (Term of Years)，但这只是它的自然寿命。地役权在自然到期前，完全可以通过其他方式（如放弃、合并、时效等）提前“死亡”。
⚠️ 考试技巧：固定期限并不提供对“时效终止”的豁免权。

🚫 错误选项辨析
选项 A (Estoppel 禁止反言)：
禁止反言要求供役地所有人信赖地役权人放弃权利的表示而改变处境。本题中是土地所有人主动封路，而非信赖邻居的某种表示。
选项 C (Not Hostile 非敌意)：
这是对事实认定的错误。建栅栏、上锁、拒给钥匙，这些行为在法律上被明确定义为“敌意” (Hostile)，即与地役权人的权利主张相冲突。
💡 助记词 DAMPER (地役权终止方式)
  • Destruction (毁损)
  • Abandonment (放弃)
  • Merger (混同)
  • Prescription (时效) ← 本题考点
  • Estoppel (禁止反言)
  • Release (解除)

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man conveyed the eastern half of a tract of vacant land to a woman by a warranty deed. The woman promptly recorded the deed. The land conveyed to the woman fronted on a public highway. The land retained by the man was landlocked.
One year later, the man died intestate, leaving a cousin as his only heir. The cousin visited the man's land for the first time and discovered that it had no access to a public highway. A neighbor who owned adjoining land fronting on the public highway offered to sell the cousin a right to cross the neighbor's land for access to the highway. Although the neighbor's price was reasonable, the cousin rejected the offer. The woman has refused to allow the cousin to cross her land for access to the public highway even though the woman's land is still vacant.
The cousin has sued the woman, seeking access across the woman's land to the public highway.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The cousin, based on necessity.
choices.B: The cousin, because the woman's land is still vacant.
choices.C: The woman, because the cousin could obtain an alternative access to the highway from the neighbor.
choices.D: The woman, because the man failed to reserve an easement in his deed to the woman.

questions.explanation:
Implied easements
Type Elements
Necessity Severance of common ownership
Strict necessity for use & enjoyment of land
Existing prior use Severance of common ownership
Prior existing use
Apparent & continuous
Reasonable necessity for use & enjoyment of land

An easement by necessity will be implied if the following elements are met:

  • Severance of common ownership – the dominant and servient estates were a single tract of land, and the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another
  • Strict necessity – the easement is absolutely necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land (eg, the dominant tract is landlocked and has no access to a public road)

This type of easement runs with the land, meaning that subsequent owners of the dominant and servient estates are bound by the easement.

A man owned a large tract of land. He conveyed the eastern portion of the tract to a woman by deed that did not reserve an easement. The man retained the western portion of the tract, which was landlocked after the conveyance because it had no access to a public road except by crossing the woman's land. The man later died, and his cousin inherited the western portion. The cousin brought suit against the woman, seeking to cross her land to reach the public highway.

Here, the man's conveyance to the woman severed the common ownership of the tract, and the cousin's inherited land is absolutely necessary for use and enjoyment because it is landlocked with no other access to a public road. Therefore, an easement will be implied based on necessity (Choice D). And since the easement runs with the land, the cousin—who inherited the man's land—will likely prevail in his suit against the woman.

(Choice B) The fact that the woman's land is vacant rather than developed has no bearing on whether the cousin has the right to cross her land to reach the public highway.

(Choice C) The cousin's ability to obtain alternative access to the public highway by purchasing an easement over the neighbor's land does not extinguish his easement by necessity over the woman's land.

📌 Educational Objective

An easement by necessity will be implied if (1) the dominant and servient estates were once a single tract of land, and the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another, and (2) the easement is absolutely necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 2.15 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement by necessity).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子通过一份一般担保地契将其一块空地的东半部分转让给了一名女子。该女子立即登记了地契。转让给女子的土地临近一条公共公路。该男子保留的土地是内陆地，不与任何公路连接。

一年后，该男子无遗嘱去世，留下一个表亲作为其唯一继承人。该表亲第一次探访该男子的土地时，发现它没有通往公共公路的通道。一位拥有临近公共公路的相邻土地的邻居提出，愿意向该表亲出售穿越其土地以通往公路的权利。尽管邻居的要价合理，该表亲还是拒绝了这一提议。该女子拒绝允许该表亲穿越其土地以通往公共公路，尽管女子的土地仍为空置。

该表亲已起诉该女子，请求获得穿越该女子土地通往公共公路的权利。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 表亲，基于必要性。
zh-choices.B: 表亲，因为该女子的土地仍为空置。
zh-choices.C: 女子，因为该表亲可以从邻居处获得通往公路的替代通道。
zh-choices.D: 女子，因为该男子未能在其给女子的地契中保留地役权。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easements (地役权)
核心考点：必要地役权 Easement by Necessity

当土地所有者分割土地，导致其中一部分土地完全失去通往公共道路的途径（成为“内陆地”/Landlocked）时，法律会默示产生一种通行权。

公共公路 (Public Highway)
女子土地
(有路)
表亲土地
(内陆地)
➞ 法律默示的通行路径
1. 成立要件 (Elements)：
  • 共同所有权的分割 (Severance of Common Ownership)： 土地原先由一人（男子）拥有，后被分割。
  • 绝对必要性 (Strict Necessity)： 分割导致保留地块在分割之时 (at the time of severance) 没有任何通往公共道路的途径。
2. 本案应用：

男子卖掉东半部分（临路）给女子，保留西半部分（内陆）。在分割的那一刻，男子的地块变成了“死地”。因此，穿越女子土地的必要地役权自动产生。

3. 继承性：

地役权依附于土地 (Runs with the land)。表亲继承了土地，也自然继承了这项通行权。

MBE 常见陷阱 (Distractor Analysis)

为什么选项 C 是错的？

题目提到邻居愿意出售通行权。很多考生会认为：“既然能买到路，就不是‘绝对必要’了吧？”

MBE 规则： 必要性是在土地分割时确定的。只要在分割那一刻产生了必要性，地役权就成立了。仅仅是第三方（邻居）提供购买通行权的机会，并不能消灭已经存在的地役权。

注意：如果表亲实际上已经购买了邻居的通行权，那么必要性消失，地役权才会终止。但仅有“要约”是不够的。

其他选项排除：
  • 选项 B (空地)： 土地是否空置与地役权是否存在无关。
  • 选项 D (未保留)： 必要地役权是默示 (Implied) 的，不需要在地契中明文写出。
应试技巧： 看到 "Landlocked" (内陆地) 和 "Severance" (分割)，首先考虑 Easement by Necessity。不要被邻居的 Offer 迷惑，除非已经成交。
